entries.text: Sent into deep space: "This is repair unit Zeeb broadcasting from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9. The Little Dart Mk 26 is 70% built. If any star hoppers or deep space beacons are out there... *bweep*... read back!"
pointing brass dish at the night sky and beaming out a signal
entries.why: Gotta point my dish up and see if anyone in deep space picks up my transmission.
